The '''''Mystic Burn''''' was a [[YT-1200 medium freighter]] owned by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Harkan Resch]], a small-time merchant bankrupted by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] blockade of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Due to the blockade, he was forced to sell the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to [[Deel Surool]] on [[Ohma-D'un/Legends|Ohma-D'un]]. 35 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long, the ship had room for four crew and four passengers, as well as 75 metric tons of cargo. It had an armored hull and modest shields, as well as a laser cannon turret. It was a short-range transport, equipped with two escape pods.<ref name="CG1" />
